text:
Evan Rodrigues came to New Jersey with two Stanley Cup rings from Florida and the label of a veteran presence. Twenty-three games later he has seven goals and 13 points, and The Hockey News has called him a secret weapon for the Devils. Heavy.com's headline had Sheldon Keefe saying he has exceeded expectations.

The hot streak is partly earned. He has eight points in his last ten, including two goals in Washington on Nov. 14, and his own chances are up (2.4 expected goals against 1.9 usual). But he is shooting 19% after 7% last season, and that kind of finishing rarely holds.

The flip side should soften any cooling. New Jersey has scored 5.6 fewer goals than its chances deserved with him on the ice, which has cost him assists. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking says he shoots a lot but not always from the slot, so the thing to watch is simple: does he keep getting inside once the shooting percentage drifts back down?
headline: Two Cups later, Evan Rodrigues is New Jersey's surprise
